name: gutlog
description: Gutlog by Meter: the food and gut database your AI assistant writes to. Log meals from a photo or a sentence with calories, macros, nutrients and ingredients (each with a confidence you can fix), scan barcodes, read your day, and check plans, from the conversation, the CLI or CI.

interface.shortDescription: Log meals and read your food diary from your agent
interface.longDescription: Log what you eat from a photo or a sentence, with calories, macros, nutrients and ingredients that each carry a confidence you can fix in one sentence. Scan barcodes, read your day, and see your plan and usage, from chat, the CLI or CI.
defaultPrompt: Log my breakfast: two scrambled eggs and a slice of sourdough toast.
What have I eaten today in Gutlog?
